ops.oldText: Vendor will be Customer's sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term.
ops.newText: Vendor will be a non-exclusive provider of hosted analytics services, and Customer may procure the same or similar services from any other supplier at any time.

input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a sole-supplier commitment, so we have made Vendor's appointment non-exclusive; our playbook position is that we retain freedom to source from other suppliers, and this also removes the conflict with Section 12.3, in which Vendor acknowledges we have made no exclusivity commitment.
input.summary: Make Vendor a non-exclusive provider; remove full-term exclusivity on Customer.
